chunks: And [remember] when they said: "O God, if this is the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment."
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers ask God to send if the Quran was truly from Him?
ai.summary: This verse, from Surah Al-Anfal, captures the arrogant challenge of the Quraysh disbelievers who demanded immediate divine retribution—such as rain of stones—if Muhammad’s message were truly from God. In Shia exegesis, this reflects their stubborn refusal to accept truth despite clear signs, illustrating the concept of 'istikbar' (arrogance) that often precedes divine punishment. It serves as a historical precedent for the pattern of denial and subsequent retribution faced by previous nations.
